from solution import prioritize_tasks


class PrioritizeTasksTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_stable_partition_with_uneven_categories(self):
        tasks = [
            {"id": 1, "category": "slow"},
            {"id": 2, "category": "fast"},
            {"id": 3, "category": "slow"},
            {"id": 4, "category": "fast"},
            {"id": 5, "category": "other"},
        ]
        result = prioritize_tasks(tasks, ["slow"])
        self.assertEqual([task["id"] for task in result], [2, 4, 5, 1, 3])
        self.assertIs(result[0], tasks[1])
        self.assertIs(result[1], tasks[3])
        self.assertIs(result[2], tasks[4])
        self.assertIs(result[3], tasks[0])
        self.assertIs(result[4], tasks[2])

    def test_empty_inputs_and_boundary_partitions(self):
        self.assertEqual(prioritize_tasks([], []), [])

        tasks = [{"category": "a"}, {"category": "b"}]
        all_ready = prioritize_tasks(tasks, [])
        all_delayed = prioritize_tasks(tasks, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(all_ready, tasks)
        self.assertEqual(all_delayed, tasks)
        self.assertIsNot(all_ready, tasks)
        self.assertIsNot(all_delayed, tasks)

    def test_duplicate_delayed_categories_are_harmless(self):
        tasks = [
            {"id": "a", "category": 1},
            {"id": "b", "category": 2},
            {"id": "c", "category": 1},
        ]
        result = prioritize_tasks(tuple(tasks), [1, 1, 1])
        self.assertEqual([task["id"] for task in result], ["b", "a", "c"])

    def test_does_not_mutate_input_or_copy_task_objects(self):
        nested = {"values": []}
        tasks = [
            {"id": 1, "category": "delayed", "nested": nested},
            {"id": 2, "category": "ready"},
        ]
        original_order = list(tasks)
        result = prioritize_tasks(tasks, {"delayed"})

        self.assertEqual(tasks, original_order)
        self.assertIs(tasks[0], original_order[0])
        self.assertIs(result[1], tasks[0])
        self.assertIs(result[1]["nested"], nested)

    def test_missing_required_category_raises_without_reordering_input(self):
        tasks = [{"id": 1, "category": "ready"}, {"id": 2}]
        original = list(tasks)
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            prioritize_tasks(tasks, {"slow"})
        self.assertEqual(tasks, original)


if __name__ == "__main__":

from solution import weave_queues


class WeaveQueuesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_round_robin_order_is_left_to_right_and_stable(self):
        queues = [["a1", "a2", "a3"], ["b1", "b2"], ["c1", "c2", "c3", "c4"]]
        self.assertEqual(
            weave_queues(queues),
            ["a1", "b1", "c1", "a2", "b2", "c2", "a3", "c3", "c4"],
        )

    def test_empty_outer_and_empty_inner_queues(self):
        self.assertEqual(weave_queues([]), [])
        self.assertEqual(weave_queues([[], (), []]), [])
        self.assertEqual(weave_queues([[], [1, 2], (), [3]]), [1, 3, 2])

    def test_single_queue_and_one_item_queues(self):
        self.assertEqual(weave_queues([(1, 2, 3)]), [1, 2, 3])
        self.assertEqual(weave_queues([[1], [2], [3]]), [1, 2, 3])

    def test_returns_original_objects(self):
        a1, a2, b1, b2 = object(), object(), object(), object()
        result = weave_queues([[a1, a2], (b1, b2)])
        expected = [a1, b1, a2, b2]
        self.assertEqual(len(result), len(expected))
        for actual, original in zip(result, expected):
            self.assertIs(actual, original)

    def test_does_not_mutate_outer_or_inner_sequences(self):
        first = [{"n": 1}, {"n": 2}]
        second = [{"n": 3}]
        queues = [first, second]
        outer_before = list(queues)
        first_before = list(first)
        second_before = list(second)

        result = weave_queues(queues)

        self.assertEqual(queues, outer_before)
        self.assertEqual(first, first_before)
        self.assertEqual(second, second_before)
        self.assertIs(result[0], first[0])
        self.assertIs(result[1], second[0])
        self.assertIs(result[2], first[1])

    def test_non_sequence_inner_value_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises((TypeError, AttributeError)):
            weave_queues([[1], None])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from solution import make_document_workflow


class DocumentWorkflowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_commit_and_rollback_lifecycle(self):
        workflow = make_document_workflow({"title": "old", "count": 1})
        self.assertEqual(workflow("view"), {
            "state": "idle",
            "document": {"title": "old", "count": 1},
        })

        workflow("begin")
        workflow("put", "title", "new")
        self.assertEqual(workflow("view"), {
            "state": "editing",
            "document": {"title": "new", "count": 1},
        })
        committed = workflow("commit")
        self.assertEqual(committed, {"title": "new", "count": 1})
        self.assertEqual(workflow("view")["state"], "idle")

        workflow("begin")
        workflow("put", "count", 99)
        rolled_back = workflow("rollback")
        self.assertEqual(rolled_back, {"title": "new", "count": 1})
        self.assertEqual(workflow("view"), {
            "state": "idle",
            "document": {"title": "new", "count": 1},
        })

    def test_input_and_put_values_are_deep_copied(self):
        initial = {"nested": {"items": [1]}}
        workflow = make_document_workflow(initial)
        initial["nested"]["items"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(workflow("view")["document"], {"nested": {"items": [1]}})

        supplied = {"values": [3]}
        workflow("begin")
        workflow("put", "added", supplied)
        supplied["values"].append(4)
        self.assertEqual(
            workflow("view")["document"]["added"],
            {"values": [3]},
        )

    def test_every_returned_snapshot_is_deeply_isolated(self):
        workflow = make_document_workflow({"items": [{"x": 1}]})
        first = workflow("view")
        first["state"] = "corrupt"
        first["document"]["items"][0]["x"] = 999
        first["document"]["items"].append({"x": 2})

        self.assertEqual(workflow("view"), {
            "state": "idle",
            "document": {"items": [{"x": 1}]},
        })

        workflow("begin")
        committed = workflow("commit")
        committed["items"][0]["x"] = 50
        self.assertEqual(workflow("view")["document"], {"items": [{"x": 1}]})

    def test_separate_workflows_share_no_mutable_state(self):
        initial = {"values": []}
        left = make_document_workflow(initial)
        right = make_document_workflow(initial)

        left("begin")
        left("put", "values", ["left"])
        left("commit")

        self.assertEqual(left("view")["document"], {"values": ["left"]})
        self.assertEqual(right("view")["document"], {"values": []})

    def test_invalid_commands_and_transitions_are_atomic(self):
        workflow = make_document_workflow({"x": 1})
        idle_before = workflow("view")
        for command in ("put", "commit", "rollback", "unknown"):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                workflow(command, "x", 2)
            self.assertEqual(workflow("view"), idle_before)

        workflow("begin")
        workflow("put", "x", 2)
        editing_before = workflow("view")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            workflow("begin")
        self.assertEqual(workflow("view"), editing_before)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            workflow("nonsense")
        self.assertEqual(workflow("view"), editing_before)

    def test_empty_document_and_none_key_are_supported(self):
        workflow = make_document_workflow({})
        workflow("begin")
        workflow("put", None, {"v": []})
        self.assertEqual(workflow("commit"), {None: {"v": []}})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        self.assertEqual(workflow.apply("c4", "reopen"), ("shipped", 4))
        self.assertEqual(workflow.state, "shipped")
        self.assertEqual(workflow.transition_count, 4)

    def test_completed_command_is_idempotent_after_state_changes(self):
        workflow = ParcelWorkflow()
        original = workflow.apply("same", "pack")
        workflow.apply("ship-command", "ship")
        workflow.apply("deliver-command", "deliver")

        self.assertEqual(workflow.apply("same", "reopen"), original)
